description: This file defines a Validator class responsible for validating input values against a set of rules in a human resource management system. It includes methods for performing validation, handling exceptions, and collecting relevant validation rules.

classes.name: Validator
classes.description: A class providing static methods for validating input data against specified rules, with detailed error handling and rule application logic.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation of input values against provided rules, throwing exceptions on validation failure.

methods.name: getOnlyNecessaryValues
methods.description: Filters input values to include only those necessary for validation based on the rules, excluding any specified keys.
